# Acorn House Buyer

> Acorn House Buyer buys houses for cash across North Carolina, as-is and in any condition. No repairs, no commissions, and we pay the normal seller closing costs. Written cash offer usually within 24 hours; close in 7 to 14 days or on the seller's date, through a licensed NC closing attorney.

Acorn House Buyer is a real estate investment company, not a brokerage. It buys directly from owners and may assign purchase contracts to partner investors (disclosed to the seller).

- Phone: (704) 246-3399
- Email: info@acornhousebuyer.com
- Based in: Charlotte, NC
